findings.title: Observer fault containment is not true under actual Node diagnostics/stream semantics
cause: Node diagnostics_channel reports subscriber exceptions asynchronously; try/catch around publish cannot contain them. The author mock instead throws directly from publish.
stderr.write can return normally and later emit an unhandled error; the synchronous catch does not contain that failure.
findings.impact: A supposedly observational fault can kill the actual child while business/physical ownership is unsettled, violating the non-interference contract.
findings.minimalFix: Use a bounded private fault-contained sink or another mechanism that contains actual subscriber and asynchronous output errors; mark capture incomplete/disable observation without throwing into or globally swallowing business errors. Preserve the five await edits, all await operands, existing catch/finally and cancellation/ownership behavior. Add these two actual Node regressions; do not build a new tracing framework.

otherwiseAccepted: Original await operands/order/error handling and listener final mutation are retained by the textual five-boundary patch.
No new wait/race/timer/abort listener/admission change is introduced.
Controlled collector projection contains fixed scalar metadata only, and normal records are capped128 with an incomplete marker.
Default-off candidate is not installed; synthetic-only use is a launch contract that still needs real argv/env/path/hash freeze, not enforced merely by the flag.

sandboxAssessment.classification: sandbox-exec was started; macOS refused sandbox activation. No evidence of an automatic tool-approval rejection. The precise outer-policy/environment cause is unknown.
notInferred: a grant to run outside the restriction
sandboxAssessment.minimalLawfulCheck: Parent may separately assign exactly one side-effect-free /usr/bin/true launch through the same normal execution channel and byte-identical profile. This checks existing capability without changing policy or retrying Git/Host; current review does not execute it. No escalation, alternative API, changed profile or outside-controller route. A fresh explicit approval denial stops; repeated EPERM goes to environment capability resolution, not looped probes.
laterExecutionGates: Fix observer fault containment and freeze reviewed bytes.
Explicitly release only the same-policy empty capability probe; record exact argv/profile hash/exit/stdout/stderr.
If successful, final synthetic launch argv/cwd/env/copy paths/claim/deadline/group wiring require the already planned mechanical review.
No automatic Gateway launch from an empty-command success. No paid main retry under exhausted authorization.
